story.headline: Scientists Identified 10 Healthy Diets Linked to Slower Biological Aging
story.summary: Scientists Identified 10 Healthy Diets Linked to Slower Biological Aging
story.score_reason: Health study credible, but global, no Malaysia data

carousel.cover_headline:
10 Diets Linked to
Slower Biological Aging —
Any One May Help

slides.label: WHAT IS THIS
slides.headline: Biological age is how fast your body is wearing out
slides.insight: It does not always match the age on your IC.

slides.label: THE STUDY
slides.headline: Researchers studied **6,470 people** aged 30 and over
slides.insight: All 10 diets were linked to slower biological aging.

slides.label: WHY IT MATTERS
slides.headline: Slower aging is linked to lower risk of dementia and cardiovascular disorders
slides.insight: "Effects are measurable and relevant for prevention," say researchers.

slides.label: GOOD NEWS
slides.headline: You do not need to follow all 10 diets at once
slides.insight: Sticking to even one was associated with slower biological aging.

slides.label: TRY THIS WEEK
slides.headline: Pick one meal today and add more vegetables and less sugar
slides.insight: Small, consistent swaps are what the research points to.

sources: German Centre for Neurodegenerative Diseases (DZNE), published in Nature Communications (reported by ScienceAlert, 2026)
carousel.caption:
10 diets have been linked to slower biological aging — and you only need to start with one.

Researchers from DZNE studied 6,470 people aged 30 and over and found that healthier eating was associated with slower biological aging across all 10 diet patterns.

Biological aging affects the risk of dementia and cardiovascular disorders, and researchers say even measurable differences matter for prevention.

Which meal in your day do you think is easiest to make healthier?

Not medical advice.

Sources: German Centre for Neurodegenerative Diseases (DZNE), Nature Communications (reported by ScienceAlert, 2026)
